title: Story types
description: Manage story types used in project journals

help.title: About Story types
help.overview: A Story type classifies journal stories (news, milestone, press, and similar). Every story requires one type. This is not a construction-update category and not a snag type.

sections.title: What a story type holds
items: Optional sort order — select lists and this page order types by sort order, then name. Leave empty to treat as 0.
Slug is generated from the company name plus the type name. You do not type it.

sections.title: On this page
items: Create, search, and edit story types.
Delete is a soft delete, but it is blocked while any story still uses this type.

sections.title: How it behaves
items: Stories (marketing journal) pick a type from this list. Construction updates have their own page and do not use story types.
Changing sort order only changes how types appear in pickers. Existing stories keep their type.

sections.title: Typical next step
items: Create the types your journal needs.
On Stories, pick a type when you write an article, then publish when copy is ready.
